changes_made.explanation: Normalized dataset name 'CC' to full form 'Conversation Chronicles (CC)' and consolidated output descriptions. Removed duplicate 'CC' from datasets.
Simplified all metric variants to base forms (BLEU-N → BLEU, ROUGE-L → ROUGE, ACC → Accuracy, Distinct-1/2/3 → Distinct)
Removed placeholder 'None' values and confirmed no LLM-as-judge evaluation was used in this paper

guideline: Evaluators assessed responses based on coherence, fluency, and engagingness
Human evaluators rate the system on coherence (topic and logic consistency across sessions), fluency (naturalness of interaction), and engagingness (interest and willingness to continue chatting)

changes_made.explanation: Kept the guideline descriptions and criteria as extracted - they are accurate and comprehensive

overall_notes: The extraction quality is generally good overall. The paper primarily focuses on dialogue generation but also involves text summarization for event memory extraction. All metrics and evaluation procedures are well-documented. The human evaluation criteria are clearly defined. Paper does not use LLM-as-judge evaluation.
